note: ADR 1049: a literal handed to an identity wrapper (`function same(cb) { return cb }`) runs where the call's value runs, and a generator stepped once where it is made runs its body up to the first `yield` on that `next()` call: the static `dynamic` promise (DYNAMIC_STATIC_PROMISE) and `useContext` with no provider (CONTEXT_NOT_FOUND) throw in the component body and the page reports them (violations). A wrapper that also stores, a conditional return, a caught call, a site after a `yield`, a stored iterator and a returned object literal stay uncertifiable.
